o: Season 2 finds Dexter caught between two killers, one notorious and the other terrorizing New York in ways no one ever anticipated, all while battling his greatest enemy yet, a mid-life crisis. Harrison continues his own pursuit of justice as father and son face their darkest chapter.

v.n: Season 2 Official Teaser and Date Announcement
Season 2 Special Announcement from Michael C. Hall

eps.o: Dexter struggles to find purpose beyond the hunt as Harrison begins his NYPD career. A brazen new murderer puts the city on edge.
Navigating his mid-life crisis, Dexter finds no comfort as The Five Borough Killer captivates New York. Harrison starts at NYPD Homicide.
Dexter closes in on a ruthless killer terrorizing the city, but a fleeting clue is all he has to go on. Harrison settles into his new role at NYPD.
Dexter probes a young killer's notorious legacy and must decide whether the Code still applies. Meanwhile, Harrison proves himself in the field.

A familiar face from Dexter's past resurfaces, challenging his beliefs and reshaping his next move. As Harrison takes on greater responsibility within the NYPD, the hunt for The Five Borough Killer intensifies across New York.
